main.description: Register a localhost URL where the AppView will POST notifications for the authenticated caller in cursor order. Replays notifications after `cursor`; legacy `since` is translated loss-safely for dormant pre-cursor sessions. Re-registration overwrites the prior URL. Spec: specs/notification-push.md.

url.description: Where to POST notifications. Must be of the form http://127.0.0.1:<port>/... (localhost only).

cursor.description: Opaque notification cursor previously returned by this endpoint or attached to a pushed notification. Mutually exclusive with `since`.

since.description: Deprecated ISO notification checkpoint retained for dormant sessions. Null means no checkpoint for old clients. The AppView normalizes a datetime to an opaque cursor and inclusively replays the boundary millisecond. Mutually exclusive with `cursor`.

cursor.description: Normalized opaque starting cursor for this registration. Persist with compare-and-swap so concurrent live delivery cannot regress it.
